payload.title: The web picks the workforce slice from client state rather than the URL: the same /hr/* pages are mounted in the farm, greenhouse, sensor and Company workspaces, the slice comes from whichever workspace the shell follows, and an absent provider or the Company workspace means every module
evidence: web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/shared.ts:48-63 (teamArea lists the same /hr/* pages for every module workspace; it is mounted by aqua.ts:51, gh.ts:39 and ctl.ts:82)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/org.ts:52-61 (Company lists the same HR pages again as the all-modules view)
web/shell/src/console/shell/useFollowedWorkspace.ts:5-7 (a page the current workspace shares keeps the stored workspace, so the URL does not decide the slice)
web/shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx:129 (workforce scope = workforceScopeOf(followed workspace), provided to the routed page at 260-262)
web/shared-ui/src/contexts/WorkforceScopeContext.tsx:32 (the context default is null, documented at 10-11 as every module)
web/modules/hr-module/src/hooks/useModuleScope.ts:19-21 (requests send explicit ?? workspace ?? undefined, and undefined means everyone)
payload.rule_violated: Plan PKG-28 and contract rule C2: the URL picks the slice, the server enforces it, and a client module argument only narrows a scope the server derives (D5: a module manager sees only their slice).
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-28, release R9.
